title.ja: 伝統ある古典部の再生
title.zh: 深具传统的古籍研究社之重生
title.en: The Return of the Time-Honored Classic Lit Club
title.x-jat: Dentou Aru Koten Bu no Saisei

1.overview: "Energy conservationist" Hotaro Oreki joins the Classic Lit Club at his high school at his sister's behest, to keep it from being shut down. Also joining the club are his best friend, Satoshi Fukube, and Eru Chitanda, a curious girl who enjoys mysteries.
1.summary:
"Energy conservationist" Hotaro Oreki joins the Classic Lit Club at his high school at his sister`s behest, to keep it from being shut down. Also joining the club are his best friend, Satoshi Fukube, and Eru Chitanda, a curious girl who enjoys mysteries.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 名誉ある古典部の活動
title.zh: 值得夸耀的古籍研究社之活动
title.en: The Prestigious Classic Lit Club`s Activities
title.x-jat: Meiyo Aru Koten Bu no Katsudou

2.overview: Eru grows bored of the club's lack of activities, and suggests that they prepare an anthology to submit for the school's culture festival in the fall. While tracking down previous anthologies, the club discovers a mystery in the school's library.
2.summary:
Eru grows bored of the club`s lack of activities, and suggests that they prepare an anthology to submit for the school`s culture festival in the fall. While tracking down previous anthologies, the club discovers a mystery in the school`s library.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 事情ある古典部の末裔
title.zh: 另有隐情的古籍研究社之后裔
title.en: The Circumstances of the Classic Lit Club`s Scion
title.x-jat: Jijou Aru Koten Bu no Matsuei

3.overview: Over coffee, Eru opens up to Oreki to explain why she joined the club, and asks him for his help with a personal matter. Still unable to locate any anthologies, the club members run into an obstacle when trying to search the club's previous room.
3.summary:
Over coffee, Eru opens up to Oreki to explain why she joined the club, and asks him for his help with a personal matter. Still unable to locate any anthologies, the club members run into an obstacle when trying to search the club`s previous room.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 栄光ある古典部の昔日
title.zh: 绽放荣光的古籍研究社之过往
title.en: The Classic Lit Club`s Glorious Days of Yore
title.de: Die ruhmreichen vergangenen Tage des Klassik-Klubs
title.x-jat: Eikou Aru Koten Bu no Sekijitsu

4.overview: Eru decides to solicit Satoshi and Mayaka's help hypothesizing what happened to her uncle. The club members meet at the Chitanda estate, where they present their research and surmise what they believe happened 45 years ago.
4.summary:
Eru decides to solicit Satoshi and Mayaka`s help hypothesizing what happened to her uncle. The club members meet at the Chitanda estate, where they present their research and surmise what they believe happened 45 years ago.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 歴史ある古典部の真実
title.zh: 走过历史的古籍研究社之真相
title.en: The Truth About the Historic Classic Lit Club
title.de: Die Wahrheit über den geschichtsträchtigen Klassik-Klub
title.x-jat: Rekishi Aru Koten Bu no Shinjitsu

5.overview: Hotaro is torn between continuing with his "gray" life and the "rosy" life that the others live. A phone call from Hotaro's sister leads him to believe that there are pieces missing to his theory regarding the events of Sekitani's expulsion.
5.summary:
Hotaro is torn between continuing with his "gray" life and the "rosy" life that the others live. A phone call from Hotaro`s sister leads him to believe that there are pieces missing to his theory regarding the events of Sekitani`s expulsion.
Source: crunchyroll

6.overview: Hotaro's history class is interrupted by an outburst coming from Eru's math class, prompting a discussion in the Classic Lit Club about the nature of the seven deadly sins, and what might provoke Eru to become angry.
6.summary:
Hotaro`s history class is interrupted by an outburst coming from Eru`s math class, prompting a discussion in the Classic Lit Club about the nature of the seven deadly sins, and what might provoke Eru to become angry.
Source: crunchyroll

7.overview: During summer vacation, the Classic Lit Club members take a trip into the mountains to stay at a hot springs resort inn run by Mayaka's relatives. While there, Eru and Mayaka see what appears to be the ghost of a man who hanged himself!
7.summary:
During summer vacation, the Classic Lit Club members take a trip into the mountains to stay at a hot springs resort inn run by Mayaka`s relatives. While there, Eru and Mayaka see what appears to be the ghost of a man who hanged himself!
Source: crunchyroll

8.overview: One of Eru's acquaintances invites the Classic Lit Club to a screening of a student film made by the members of Class 2-F so they can offer their opinions. When the movie takes an unexpected turn, the club is called on to help find a solution.
8.summary:
One of Eru`s acquaintances invites the Classic Lit Club to a screening of a student film made by the members of Class 2-F so they can offer their opinions. When the movie takes an unexpected turn, the club is called on to help find a solution.
Source: crunchyroll

title.en: The Case of the Furuoka Deserted Village Murder
title.de: Der Mordfall des verlassenen Dorfes Furuoka
title.ar: جريمة قتل في مدينة فوروكا الصحراوية

9.overview: In search of a conclusion to their movie, the assistant director, the prop master, and the publicist meet with the Classic Lit Club members one at a time to propose their solutions to the unfinished murder mystery.
9.summary:
In search of a conclusion to their movie, the assistant director, the prop master, and the publicist meet with the Classic Lit Club members one at a time to propose their solutions to the unfinished murder mystery.
Source: crunchyroll

10.overview: After meeting with Irisu, Hotaro has a change of heart, and sets his mind to solving the murder mystery. Hotaro and Satoshi discuss the nature of their own potential, and what each of them might be able to accomplish.
10.summary:
After meeting with Irisu, Hotaro has a change of heart, and sets his mind to solving the murder mystery. Hotaro and Satoshi discuss the nature of their own potential, and what each of them might be able to accomplish.
Source: crunchyroll

11.overview: When the others ask Hotaro about his solution to the murder mystery, he begins to have doubts about it himself. Hotaro confronts Irisu regarding the reason why she called the Classic Lit Club in to help finish the film.
11.summary:
When the others ask Hotaro about his solution to the murder mystery, he begins to have doubts about it himself. Hotaro confronts Irisu regarding the reason why she called the Classic Lit Club in to help finish the film.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 限りなく積まれた例のあれ

12.overview: It is the first day of the school culture festival, and the club members look forward to it with both longing and dread. They must come up with a way to sell all of the copies of "Hyouka" that were printed, as dauntless as the task seems.
12.summary:
It is the first day of the school culture festival, and the club members look forward to it with both longing and dread. They must come up with a way to sell all of the copies of "Hyouka" that were printed, as dauntless as the task seems.
Source: crunchyroll

13.overview: Satoshi tries to use the Quiz Club's quiz show event to promote the Classic Lit Club. Eru goes around beating the bushes for ways to help sell all of the copies of "Hyouka." More and more items end up missing from various clubs.
13.summary:
Satoshi tries to use the Quiz Club`s quiz show event to promote the Classic Lit Club. Eru goes around beating the bushes for ways to help sell all of the copies of "Hyouka." More and more items end up missing from various clubs.
Source: crunchyroll

14.overview: The Classic Lit Club cooking team competes against three other teams in the Cooking Club's timed "Wild Fire" competition. However, Mayaka is delayed drawing posters for the Manga Club. Will she be able to finish in time to compete?
14.summary:
The Classic Lit Club cooking team competes against three other teams in the Cooking Club`s timed "Wild Fire" competition. However, Mayaka is delayed drawing posters for the Manga Club. Will she be able to finish in time to compete?
Source: crunchyroll

15.overview: Eru's curiosity is drawn by the rash of thefts from the various clubs, and when Hotaro discovers a pattern to the crimes, Satoshi comes up with a way to publicize the Classic Lit Club through the school newspaper so they can sell their anthologies.
15.summary:
Eru`s curiosity is drawn by the rash of thefts from the various clubs, and when Hotaro discovers a pattern to the crimes, Satoshi comes up with a way to publicize the Classic Lit Club through the school newspaper so they can sell their anthologies.
Source: crunchyroll

16.overview: Satoshi is ready for Jumoji to strike, but when the anticipated target is passed over, he must reconsider his strategy. Tomoe gives Hotaro a copy of "A Corpse By Evening," and Eru notices that the art style is similar to one she has seen elsewhere.

17.overview: Eru appears on a school radio show, asking all the other students to stand with the Classic Lit Club against the phantom thief. Hotaro confronts the person he believes to be Jumoji. Satoshi comes to terms with his expectations.
17.summary:
Eru appears on a school radio show, asking all the other students to stand with the Classic Lit Club against the phantom thief. Hotaro confronts the person he believes to be Jumoji. Satoshi comes to terms with his expectations.

18.overview: While chatting in the club room after school, Hotaro remembers how one of his teachers in middle school famously liked helicopters. But when the others dispute the characterization, Hotaro wonders if there is something more to it.
18.summary:

title.x-jat: Kokoro Atari no Aru Mono wa

19.overview: Hotaro tells Eru that he can come up with a plausible explanation for any situation she can think of, so when a seemingly mundane schoolwide announcement is made, she challenges him to figure out the reason behind the announcement.
19.summary:
Hotaro tells Eru that he can come up with a plausible explanation for any situation she can think of, so when a seemingly mundane schoolwide announcement is made, she challenges him to figure out the reason behind the announcement.

title.ja: あきましておめでとう

20.overview: At New Year's, Eru invites Hotaro to join her in paying her family's respects at the town shrine. When Eru agrees to run a quick errand, however, she and Hotaro find themselves in an unexpected and compromising situation.
20.summary:

title.ja: 手作りチョコレート事件
title.en: The Case of the Homemade Chocolates

21.overview: While in middle school, Satoshi rejected Mayaka's Valentine chocolate, so this year, she works even harder to present him with a Valentine's Day masterpiece. But when it turns up missing, the search is on to discover what happened to it.
21.summary:

title.en: The Doll That Took the Long Way Around

22.overview: Hotaro is enlisted by Eru to appear in a Dolls' Festival parade that her local shrine holds every year. When construction work unexpectedly causes a last-minute detour, it leaves the participants wondering what went awry.
